Carla (finance): Noticing a spike in duplicate credit memos from last night's billing sync. About 34 customers affected, same Stripe refund id but two NetSuite CMs.
Ethan (eng): Thanks — any pattern on times?
Carla (finance): All between 02:05-02:20 UTC; sample refund rf_9aBcD -> NS CM-7701 + CM-7702.
ops-bot: deploy complete: release/2026-05-01-02:00 by @Ethan
Ethan (eng): We rolled a header-normalization rule on the edge to help partner vendors. It lowercased some headers including the signature header. Our verifier is strict on header key case.
billing-bot: ERR billing:webhook - signature invalid for evt_9aBcD; INFO billing:enqueue-replay evt_9aBcD attempt=1
NetSuite-bot: INFO netsuite-sync - created credit_memo CM-7701 for refund rf_9aBcD
NetSuite-bot: INFO netsuite-sync - created credit_memo CM-7702 for refund rf_9aBcD (replayed)
Ethan (eng): Root cause: edge mutated signature header name -> verification failed -> replay path produced a different idempotency key because we hashed the full raw request (headers included).
Carla (finance): Proposed remediation: auto-void later credit memo when external_ref (refund id) and amount match and created within 10 minutes. ~34 customers. Need approval.
Ethan (eng): Fix plan: 1) make signature lookup case-insensitive, 2) compute idempotency from stable fields (stripe_event_id + refund_id), 3) revert header normalization for /webhooks. Hotfix rolling now.
ops-bot: Ticket FIN-9001 created: "Edge header lowercase -> webhook replay duplicates" assigned to Ethan, priority P1.
Carla (finance): Approved for auto-void up to 50 accounts after hotfix confirmed. Please run a dry-run first and post results to #finance-updates.
Ethan (eng): Hotfix deployed at 1745011200, edge logs show signature headers preserved. Will run dry-run then backfill.
Carla (finance): Thanks everyone. Will standby for backfill output. :thumbsup:
